description: Bhagiradha Chemicals & Industries Limited manufactures and sells crop protection chemicals in India, rest of Asia, and Europe. The company offers insecticides, such as chlorpyrifos, chlorpyrifos-methyl, diafenthiuron, fipronil, dinotefuran, thiamethoxam, imidacloprid, pymetrozine, and chlorantraniliprole; fungicides, including azoxystrobin and trifloxystrobin; herbicides comprising triclopyr, cloquintocet-mexyl, clodinafop-propargyl, sulfosulfuron, and pinoxaden; and specialty intermediates consisting of 2,6-dichloroaniline and 2-ethylsulfonylimidazo pyridine-3-sulfonamide. It serves agrochemical manufacturers and pesticide formulators and traders. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
